sources.title: Fire Explorers | James City County, VA

evidence.quote: The program is open to young men and women ages 14 (and completed the eighth grade) through 20 years old.

Fire Explorers get to train with professional firefighters and paramedics to learn real life rescue skills such as rope repelling, vehicle extrication, fire hose operations and first aid. They also participate in community service projects.
Time commitment involves monthly meetings, in addition to periodic special training and service events.
